description: A Perl script for generating random maps for the game Wesnoth, including terrain, towns, and castles, with configurable parameters.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the script.

methods.name: abort_with_error
methods.description: Terminates execution with an error message.

methods.name: add_terrain
methods.description: Adds terrain features to the map based on configuration.

methods.name: add_towns
methods.description: Places towns on the map ensuring minimum distances.

methods.name: add_castles
methods.description: Places castles for players on the map with preferred distances.

methods.name: _get_min_max_sizes
methods.description: Calculates the number and size of terrain features to place.

methods.name: _town_ok_to_place
methods.description: Checks if a town can be placed at given coordinates.

methods.name: _castle_ok_to_place
methods.description: Checks if a castle can be placed at given coordinates.

methods.name: _scan_border
methods.description: Checks if a location is near the map border.

methods.name: _scan_ring
methods.description: Scans in a ring around a location for specific terrain types.

methods.name: _is_castle
methods.description: Determines if a map cell represents a castle.

methods.name: surround
methods.description: Surrounds a location with a specified terrain type.

methods.name: place_round
methods.description: Places a round-shaped terrain feature on the map.

methods.name: _is_placeable
methods.description: Checks if a map cell is suitable for placing terrain.

methods.name: level_terrain
methods.description: Levels terrain features to create more natural transitions.

methods.name: _level_terrain
methods.description: Levels a specific cell based on neighboring terrain.

methods.name: _move_direction
methods.description: Calculates new coordinates based on direction.

methods.name: _get_next_map_square
methods.description: Determines the next map square for terrain placement.

methods.name: fill_map
methods.description: Fills remaining map spaces with the base terrain type.

methods.name: print_map
methods.description: Outputs the generated map to standard output.

methods.name: generate_base_map
methods.description: Initializes the map grid with placeholder characters.
